newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CIL Holdings places 113.9 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: CIL Holdings places 113.9 mln new shares.

text.p: CIL Holdings Ltd said on Monday it would place 113.88 million new shares, or 20 percent of the enlarged share capital, at HK$0.579 per share.
The building-related contracting services group said 70.43 million of the new shares, or 12.4 percent of the enlarged share capital, would be placed with independent third parties.

Capital Link Worldwide Ltd would receive 45.55 million shares, Silver Stone Development Ltd would get 22.78 million shares and Super Success Investments Ltd would get 2.1 million shares, CIL said in a statement.
The three parties, none of which now hold any CIL shares, have undertaken that they will not dispose of shares for a period of six months, it said.
Richard Harvest Corp, which currently holds 12.7 percent of CIL's existing share capital, would subscribe to 43.45 million new shares, or 7.6 percent of the enlarged share capital.
Richard's stake in CIL will be increased to 101.45 million shares, or 17.8 percent of the enlarged share capital, on completion of the deal on March 7, the statement said.
CIL's share capital will be enlarged to 569.43 million shares from 455.55 million shares on completion of the placement.
CIL said net proceeds of HK$65.18 million would be used for working capital for its construction operations and to expand the geographic and business scope of its activities.
The company said it was considering a number of investment opportunities in China to expand its construction operations.
CIL said it was in talks over two real estate development projects in Xuanwu district in Beijing and one in Shanghai in which the company will be co-developer and construction manager.
